free_tier.stated: Per-second billing with no free compute allowance. Domestic region China (Yangzhou 1), current prices from 19 November 2026: CNY 0.00002 per vCPU per second (CNY 0.072 per vCPU-hour) and CNY 0.00001 per GiB per second (CNY 0.036 per GiB-hour), 1 to 8 cores and 512 MiB to 8192 MiB in 512 MiB steps. Overseas region US (Dallas 1): CNY 0.0000405 per vCPU per second (CNY 0.1458 per vCPU-hour) and CNY 0.00002025 per GiB per second (CNY 0.0729 per GiB-hour). Each sandbox gets 20 GiB of local disk free. Persistent storage includes 10 GiB per account per month free, then CNY 0.000145 per GiB-hour in the domestic region or CNY 0.00019575 per GiB-hour in the overseas region. Network traffic is not billed separately. A 2 vCPU / 2 GiB sandbox running 8 hours a day with 15 GiB persistent storage is about CNY 1.75 per day by the page's worked example.

notes: This is the cheapest per-vCPU sandbox rate documented, at CNY 0.108 per vCPU-hour, and it is the only provider here that publishes a US region alongside a mainland one. It is recorded as fails-identity because the free allowance is gated on real-name verification and topping up needs a Chinese payment method; the sandbox compute itself has no free allowance at all, so even a verified account starts at CNY 0.432 per hour for 2 vCPU and 4 GiB. No USD figure is computed because no exchange rate was read verification. Isolation is described as system-level per-instance virtualization; the page does not name the technology. Qiniu also sells (LAS) as an ordinary VPS from CNY 14.2 per month domestic and offers a 2-core / 2 GB instance at CNY 66 per year for new customers in Singapore, Tokyo, Hong Kong and Changshan.
